luskin.boundary: Penk/Pnoc/Tac1/Sst/Nps/Gal/Npy are not directly measured in the current 27-gene panel; reference-imputed peptide propensities are not used as direct tissue evidence.

su.boundary: Section holdout is anatomical generalization, not independent-animal replication; VTA/PCRT is only a two-target projection analogue.

mapmycells.boundary: MapMyCells is an external taxonomy stress test/context layer, not the authority that defines Fine26.

principle: Each external framework gets its own direct quantitative panel and explicit evidence boundary; none is collapsed into a single binary support score.
